# Height Calculator — Comprehensive LLM Knowledge Base

> Website: https://height-calculator.net  
> Purpose: Free height calculator — compare, convert & understand any height. Height percentiles (CDC/WHO growth charts), child adult-height prediction from parents' heights, cm ↔ ft/in conversion, and true-scale side-by-side visual comparison for babies, boys, girls and adults.

---

## 1. System Architecture & Measurement Engine

Height Calculator uses a mathematically calibrated scaling pipeline designed to render side-by-side silhouettes and models with accurate real-world proportions:
- Ground Anchor: All standing figures share a common floor baseline ($Y = 0$).
- Proportional Scaling: Heights are converted from centimeters to stage pixels according to dynamic canvas heights (default ~620px viewport baseline).
- Unit Conversions:
  - $1 \text{ inch} = 2.54 \text{ cm}$
  - $\text{Feet \& Inches}: \text{feet} = \lfloor \frac{\text{cm}}{30.48} \rfloor, \text{inches} = \text{round}((\frac{\text{cm}}{30.48} - \text{feet}) \times 12)$
- Supported Formats: Metric (meters, centimeters), Imperial (feet, inches).
- Percentile Engine: Heights are ranked against CDC growth-chart reference tables (ages 2–20) and WHO Child Growth Standards (birth–5) for the matching age and sex.
- Child Height Predictor: Mid-parental height method — boys: $(\text{father} + \text{mother} + 13\text{ cm}) \div 2$; girls: $(\text{father} + \text{mother} - 13\text{ cm}) \div 2$ — reported with a typical range of ±8–10 cm. Estimates only, never exact, never medical advice.

---

## 2. Tools and URLs

### Core Platform
- **Height Calculator Hub:** `https://height-calculator.net/height-calculator/`  
  Percentile checks, growth charts, child height prediction and unit conversion in one place.
- **Interactive Canvas:** `https://height-calculator.net/`  
  Supports up to 10 entities simultaneously. Features include color assignment, opacity adjustment, drag-and-drop manual positioning, auto-align mode, zoom (50%–200%), ruler toggle (cm/ft), difference indicators, and high-resolution PNG export.
- **How to Use:** `https://height-calculator.net/how-to-use/`  
  Instructional guide for accurate height measurement, unit conversion, percentile interpretation, and growth-chart reading.

### Legacy routes (redirected)
The previous comparison routes (`/compare/`, `/height-comparison-calculator/`, `/height-difference-calculator/`, `/height-comparison-chart/`, `/height-comparison-visualizer/`, `/height-comparison-couple/`, `/size-comparison/`, and the 10 category comparison directories) now 301-redirect to the Height Calculator hub.

---

## 3. Data Sources & Honesty Policy

- **CDC growth charts** (Centers for Disease Control and Prevention): US national health survey reference data, ages 2–20.
- **WHO Child Growth Standards** (World Health Organization): multi-country study of healthy children, birth to age 5.
- **Prediction accuracy**: the mid-parental height estimate typically lands within ±8–10 cm (3–4 in) of actual adult height for most children. Genetics, nutrition, sleep and health all influence the outcome. No predictor is 100% accurate.
- **Medical disclaimer**: all results are educational estimates, not medical advice. Growth concerns should be discussed with a pediatrician.
